findings.finding: No runtime log sink on the sealed .so: logging.Setup is never invoked in the shared/embedded path, so diagnostics/logs source=runtime is permanently empty and rotation/daily logs do not exist for the candidate.
findings.evidence: diagnostics/logs runtime -> records null on every probe
findings.disposition: DN-M-C row; DN-8C must decide sink vs stderr-only contract

findings.finding: FrozenCore capture seam unwired in the sealed composition: turn admission calls diva-cognitive Prepare -> ReadFrozen which is load-only (store.Get -> not_found -> masked -32603). Capture happens only via BoundClient.Bootstrap (personactx.SessionProvider.Get -> Store.Capture) and nothing in vivy invokes Bootstrap. A fresh session's first turn fails until a core is captured out-of-band.
findings.evidence: garden probe on candidate data dir: ReadFrozen not_found -> Bootstrap captures 7 sections -> ReadFrozen OK; subsequent .so turns admit
findings.disposition: DN-M-C: wire Bootstrap into session bind/GUI onboarding or document the gap

findings.finding: module.action.invoke grant is per-process: sessions persisted from an earlier process get -32009 'module action is not authorized' on diva-cognitive actions (action.audit Outcome denied); turn/start has no such restriction.
findings.disposition: DN-M-C: durable grant or per-process re-grant on session resume

findings.finding: Shutdown cancels in-flight and suspended runs: VivyShutdown -> CancelAll terminates active/suspended runs and drops pending approvals (observed: suspended run_ce3d.. / apr_5046.. cancelled at process exit). Cross-process resume of a suspended approval is not possible.
findings.evidence: approval/list empty + run cancelled after driver exit
findings.disposition: confirm intended; document if by design

findings.finding: Sandbox-denied promptable tool fails the run at suspension admission instead of parking an approval (denial precedes suspension). Behavior is fail-closed but the run.failed message ('could not be paused') obscures the sandbox cause.
